description: Mark42 built-in extension — role-based window UI, toolbar, agent panel control, mk42d daemon client
untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, the Mark42 role, daemon and send settings from workspace settings are not used.
config.role.description: This window's Mark42 role. The daemon writes it into the role-specific `.code-workspace`. If empty, the window is unmanaged, so tabs are not moved and panels are not touched.
config.slotId.description: Session slot ID of an agent window (one session per window). Written by the daemon.
config.folderPath.description: The folder path this role window handles. If empty, the first workspace folder is used.
config.autoSend.description: Automatically sends Enter after filling in the resume prompt. If the smoke test for this extension version failed, it only fills in.
config.sender.osKeys: Focuses the agent panel, then sends Enter as OS key input
config.sender.none: Only fills in; does not send
config.pipeName.description: Use this to change the mk42d daemon named pipe name. If empty, the default name is used. A workspace value is used only in role workspaces created by the daemon.
config.trustedHomes.description: Absolute paths of daemon homes to trust in addition to the default Mark42 home (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Mark42` or `MARK42_HOME`) — for daemons started with `--home`. A role workspace is trusted only when it sits directly under `roles\<folder>\` of one of these homes. Can only be set in user settings.
config.daemonPath.description: Absolute path of the mk42d entry file (.ts/.mjs/.cjs/.js) that the hub window starts when no daemon is running (e.g. daemon\dist\mk42d.mjs). If it points to the old m42d.mjs and mk42d.mjs sits next to it, that one is used. Can only be set in user settings. If empty, nothing is started and you are only notified.
config.nodePath.description: Node 24 executable (command name or absolute path) used to start the daemon. Can only be set in user settings.
config.virtualDocPlacement.agentWindow: Keep them in the agent window
config.virtualDocPlacement.auxWindow: Move them to an auxiliary window (pop-up) (experimental)
config.virtualDocPlacement.description: Where virtual documents opened in an agent window (proposed diffs, etc.) go.
command.agentUpdate.unverified: Unverified New Agent Extension Version — Confirm Whether to Install
